idata.python:
# Piano - Main melody
# Rising notes = breathe in
# Steady notes = hold in 
# Falling notes = breathe out

# Introduction
playNote(64, beats=4, velocity=35)


# Repeat the breathing pattern 6 times
for i in range(6):

    # Breathe in - 4 beats, rising pitch
    playNote(60, beats=1, velocity=40)
    playNote(64, beats=1, velocity=40)
    playNote(67, beats=1, velocity=40)
      
    
    # Hold in - 4 beats, steady
    playNote(72, beats=1, velocity=40)
    playNote(72, beats=1, velocity=40)
    playNote(72, beats=1, velocity=40)
    playNote(72, beats=1, velocity=40)

    # Breathe out - 6 beats, falling pitch
    playNote(67, beats=1, velocity=35)
    playNote(64, beats=1, velocity=30)
    playNote(60, beats=1, velocity=30)
    playNote(55, beats=1, velocity=25)
    playNote(48, beats=1, velocity=25)

# Ending 
playNote(60, beats=4, velocity=15)
